title: halimium halimifolium subsp. rhiphaeum
intro: Halimium halimifolium subsp. rhiphaeum, commonly known as Rock Rose, is a plant species within the Cistaceae family. It has been reported to have various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rock Rose are attributed to its ability to soothe skin irritations, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
